scope: Read-only worker-run inspection interface, graph/checkpoint tests and package metadata; no neural inference or new repair score.
limits: Trusted worker SQLite/serialization and fixed installed dependencies only.
Checkpoint read is a single transaction; artifact observations are not atomic with it.
No acceptance/log/patch revalidation and no claim of model repair capability.
SQLite may create empty WAL/SHM coordination files; data and existing WAL frames remain unchanged.
Legacy experiment storage was nfs4, which is not a supported SQLite WAL substrate; legacy observations are not a supported-deployment guarantee.
